invariants.rationale: properties is used as a receiver in properties.put in the Runnable, so must not be null.
Name is used as a key in properties.put, so it should be non-null and non-empty.
value is passed to Integer.parseInt, which requires a non-null argument.
value should be a valid integer string to avoid NumberFormatException at Integer.parseInt.
Suggests that it may be safe to (re)set the property named 'name' during load.
